scope: replace rule message/explanation/source provenance only; preserve action, condition and dose history

action.message: GFR above 20 through 30 mL/min: obtain Consultant and pharmacy review before carboplatin. This conservative review band is an authored safety policy; NCCP 00418 itself specifies no 30 mL/min cutoff, but does state increased marrow toxicity risk below 60 and no administration at or below 20.

source.implementation_note: The >20–30 review band is authored safety policy, not a threshold in NCCP00418. The cited p4 supports ≤20 do-not-administer and<60 myelosuppression risk. Independent local clinical/pharmacy validation remains pending.
